FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: Price Above MA20 Amid Mild Dollar Strength and Geopolitical Tensions
tldr_points: USD/JPY trades above MA20 indicating short-term bullish bias.
Iran-U.S. tensions and higher oil prices support risk‑off flows that could boost the yen, but dollar strength from Beige Book and GBPUSD weakness outweighs.
Technical setup favors a long near 160.00 with target 162.00 and stop 159.00.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY holds above MA20 as dollar gains outweigh safe‑haven yen pressure; long targeting 162.00 with stop 159.00 levels
FX.comment: Price above MA20 with bullish fundamentals supports a long toward 162.00

STOCKS.excerpt: S&P 500 faces downward pressure as inflation data and geopolitical tensions outweigh current technical momentum.
STOCKS.comment: Inflationary pressure and geopolitical risk outweigh technical support above MA20.
